name: lemonad
description: JavaScript functional programming library, inspired by the Clojure, ML, Haskell and Forth.

scripts.docs: npm run docs:clean && npm run docs:api && npm run docs:annotations
scripts.docs:clean: shx rm -f docs/site/api.html docs/site/API.md docs/site/annotations.html && shx rm -rf docs/site/annotations-assets
scripts.docs:api: mkdirp docs/site && npm run docs:api:md && npm run docs:api:check && npm run docs:api:html
scripts.docs:api:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='docs/site/API.md'; const s=fs.existsSync(p) ? fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').trim() : ''; if (!s) { console.error('No API docs generated. jsdoc2md found no parseable JSDoc doclets.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.docs:annotations: docco -o docs/site/annotations-assets lib/lemonad.js && shx mv docs/site/annotations-assets/lib/lemonad.html docs/site/annotations.html && npm run docs:annotations:fix
scripts.docs:annotations:fix: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='docs/site/annotations.html'; let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); s=s.replaceAll('../docco.css','annotations-assets/docco.css').replaceAll('../public/','annotations-assets/public/'); fs.writeFileSync(p,s);"
